title: Missing labels in "Limited files with a single pre-existing value (required) field."

latest.text: Thanks for providing that! I used ANDI to help test and am seeing the issue you are describing. Before After Since this is a 1 line change really think maybe we don't need a dedicated test. Any git history would point to this ticket

I think there is a better fix possible. The problem is coming from \Drupal\file\Hook\FileThemeHooks::preprocessFileWidgetMultiple where it does unset($widget['display']['#title']); - if we changed that to $widget['display']['#title_display'
